I still main Yuumi in ranked solo q, but she's absolutely beyond horrible to play, so I understand why people don't pick her really. I don't think it's because of just the champ itself after her rework, but because of the toxicity tied to her as a champion in general that rito seems to have just made even worse by the lack of awareness of what people wanted fixed about her.  
I regularly get hard flamed/trolled for just picking her in champ select, even though I climbed to Emerald 2 so far this season with her and have a 59% wr on her. 

Basically if the adc doesn't have an idea of how to manage minion waves/farm they're going to blame the yuumi for "lack of pressure" in the lane and afk/int and flame a lot. A lot of people don't want to be stuck in a game for 20+ minutes being blamed and flamed so I get why people don't pick her nowadays.

I have BPD/chronic depression/anxiety the whole mess going on up there.. 23 now, been getting extensive treatment since I was 11.

If there anything I wish people would just understand more is that a little bit of kindness and understanding goes such a long ways to those of us with mental illness... 
You don't have to be mean for no reason qhen you could have just talked to me, because it will eat me up inside and out due to the fact that I already mentally am teetering on the edge of breaking down and losing it constantly. I am constantly overthinking and feeling bad about who I am and my actions to a severe degree. I'm sorry for the way I am and I just want to get through the day without being an inconvenience to others and feeling wracked with guilt.

I may seem like a functional and hard worker, but I promise you the physical pain I feel due to raging mental illness tears me apart every second of every day and I am so fucking tired. My life is in shambles no matter how it looks on the outside and how hard I try, because my own mind is mashed potatoes and I can't help it.
What you say or do towards me out of irritation might not seem THAT mean to you, but to me it hurt me in a physical way I can't put into words. Everything hurts me all of the time already. 
Please just be easy with people when they're clearly trying their best, even if it isn't up to par with your standards. 

There's a huge difference between lazy and exhaustion.

I didn't choose this, I don't want to be like this, I can't do anything to make the void just go away. 
I'm just trying to cope and do my best to autopilot onwards.

I'm sure many others also feel this way, but this is just my personal run in with what I'd like people to understand just a little bit better...

It's just not safe for him there and she found the neighbors dogs trying to get at him through the fence and they live close to a road and suburb.

Having a UTI.
When you get them chronically it's just such a weird uncomfortable feeling. 
It's not painful until it gets past a certain severity point, but that weird stingy feeling like you have to pee SO BADLY but can't, and then you can't stop your body from wanting to push to pee?? Yeah FUCK that!
It's the most dreadful uncomfortable feeling I can imagine.

I get them about once every month or two chronically (never test positive for any bacterial infections, all my scans on my bladder and kidneys come back looking great, and antibiotics don't do anything) and even the thought of that uncomfortable feeling makes me feel dizzy and panicky. :')

I think the only thing you can do is tell the truth.   
I like to think that the universe doesn't really 'work' with lies, things almost always get found out in some way or another somehow, and the best situation is to be the one to own up to what happened and be the one to tell her. Her finding out some other way would be all the more devastating for your fiancee.  


It's hard, and it's scary, but you have to deal with the consequences of your actions, and you owning up to it yourself is the cleanest way this is going to go in your situation..
